mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate levels (below 1.0%) indicate accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL signal tightening monetary policy amid rising inflation, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL rising) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth above 2.5% and UNRATE below 4.5%) create overvaluation risks and anticipation of policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle regime, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (base year 2017) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annualized) pressures the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annually, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High residential construction starts (HOUST above 1,250,000 units) indicate strong housing market activity that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1,250,000 units, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly) supports robust consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
